description:
A useful subsidy offer can be easy to lose in a busy game. Subsidy Manager keeps your opportunities together, so you can spend less time searching through notifications and more time planning your next route.

Compare your offers
See what needs delivering, where it needs to go, what you can earn and how long you have left. Payments and bonuses appear on separate lines, making rewards easier to read.

Keep track of your plans
Switch to In Progress to check your current tasks, progress and deadlines. History lets you review successful and failed subsidies while the game retains them.

One click to the details
Click any row to open the game's subsidy details, highlight the relevant locations and accept or decline an offer using the usual controls.

Easy to find, easy to use
Look for the contract icon beside Industry Statistics in the bottom-right toolbar. Start with Offered to find a new contract, In Progress to follow accepted tasks, or History to review past outcomes. Press Refresh to update the overview while it is open. A small dot on the icon lets you know new offers have arrived since you last opened the manager.

Your game, your decisions
Subsidy Manager keeps the game's subsidy rules and rewards as they are. It simply helps you see your options more clearly.
name: Subsidy Manager
summary: Compare subsidy offers, follow your progress and find your next opportunity in one place.
